meta.status: MEASURED — layout and typography read from the live reference over CDP
note: This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every design value in the app.
src/app/theme.css is GENERATED from it by scripts/generate-theme.mjs — never hand-edit theme.css.
Each entry carries a `status`: 'measured' (read off the live reference) or
'estimated' (not yet verified — a placeholder to be overwritten).
When the measurement pass lands: overwrite `value`, flip `status` to 'measured',
run `npm run theme`, and the whole app updates. No component changes required.
Every 'estimated' entry is listed in docs/ESTIMATES.md as the punch list.

sans.value: Circular, 'Airbnb Cereal VF', var(--font-figtree), -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
sans.note: Figtree is LOADED as a webfont via next/font/google in src/app/layout.tsx and exposed as --font-figtree. Before this, the stack only NAMED Circular / Airbnb Cereal — neither of which is installed anywhere — so every browser fell through to its generic sans (Arial on Windows), which is a neo-grotesque and could never match a geometric face at any size. Circular and Cereal stay ahead of it for anyone who genuinely licenses them; neither is redistributed here.
